hierarchyRules: firm_workspace_future parent is global_user and is future-only
client parent may be global_user or firm_workspace_future
matter parent must be client unless internal/system exception
session may attach to matter or client only after user confirmation
source_document must not expand read eligibility
every memory item must have exactly one primary scope
reference scopes do not expand read eligibility

scopes.description: The user's own professional identity and preferences; root of the hierarchy.
scopes.readEligibilityRule: readable in any request by the owning user only
scopes.writeEligibilityRule: user action or confirmed suggestion; explicit consent for sensitive items
scopes.consentRequirement: confirm scope; explicit consent for sensitive items
scopes.example: user is a CPA and prefers concise memos

scopes.description: Reserved for future multi-user firm workspaces. FUTURE ONLY; no Phase 8 implementation.

scopes.readEligibilityRule: readable only in requests resolved to this client
scopes.writeEligibilityRule: consented client facts only; explicit consent for sensitive facts
scopes.consentRequirement: explicit consent required for sensitive facts
scopes.retentionConcept: until client relationship ended or erased
scopes.example: client X is VAT-registered; client facts cannot become general law

scopes.description: One engagement, case, or workstream; must belong to a client unless explicitly marked internal/system.
scopes.readEligibilityRule: readable only inside this matter unless user confirms transfer
scopes.writeEligibilityRule: consented matter facts only; scope confirmation once per matter session
scopes.consentRequirement: scope confirmation required once per matter session
scopes.example: this LOA covers taxable year 2023; matter facts cannot leak across clients

scopes.description: The active conversation only; attaches to matter or client only after user confirmation, otherwise standalone.
scopes.writeEligibilityRule: automatic non-durable session context only; promotion requires consent
scopes.consentRequirement: none for session use; user confirmation required to attach to matter/client
scopes.example: assume 8% option for this computation only

scopes.description: Provenance/reference attachment to an indexed source. Reference scope only; never expands read eligibility; cannot assert currentness.
scopes.readEligibilityRule: provenance context only; never expands read eligibility; cannot assert currentness
scopes.writeEligibilityRule: no durable writes in Phase 8; defers to live index state
scopes.consentRequirement: not user-personal; no consent but no durable store in Phase 8
scopes.retentionConcept: defers to live index; no durable store in Phase 8
scopes.example: provenance note for an indexed RMC document; cannot assert currentness

conceptualEntities.purpose: One stored memory fact with class, permission, primary scope, confidence, and lifecycle status.
examples: client X is VAT-registered (client_entity, client_scoped, client scope)

conceptualEntities.purpose: Scope instances forming the hierarchy chain for memory items.
examples: matter scope 'BIR LOA TY2023' with parent client scope

conceptualEntities.purpose: One client/entity profile owning client-scoped memory.
One engagement/matter profile; belongs to a client unless internal/system.
examples: BIR LOA matter for TY 2023 under client X

conceptualEntities.purpose: Immutable record of consent decisions gating durable writes.
examples: user granted storage of a client fact under client scope

conceptualEntities.purpose: Append-only audit trail of memory lifecycle events; never contains secret values.
examples: delete event recorded after a forget request

conceptualEntities.purpose: Conflict detection and resolution lifecycle records.
examples: stored VAT-registered fact contradicted by live user statement

conceptualEntities.purpose: Provenance links from memory items to sources; never citable as authority.
examples: provenance ref to an indexed RMC document

conceptualEntities.purpose: Retention rules per permission level and memory class.
Read/write policy matrix per scope type, memory class, and permission level.
examples: client_entity/client_scoped readable only in resolved client context; can_write_automatically false everywhere in early Phase 8

schemaInvariants.description: Every memory item has exactly one memory_class.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: single class from the seven approved classes
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: item with two classes or unknown class

schemaInvariants.description: Every memory item has exactly one permission_level.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: single level from the eight approved levels

schemaInvariants.description: Every memory item has exactly one primary_scope_type.
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: item with primary scope in both client and matter

schemaInvariants.description: Every memory item has exactly one primary_scope_id.
schemaInvariants.examplePass: item bound to one matter scope id
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: item bound to two matter ids

schemaInvariants.description: Every durable memory item has consent_event_id unless class/permission is system_governance.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: durable write carries a granted consent event
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: durable client fact with no consent event

schemaInvariants.description: Prohibited memory cannot be stored; no value echo into logs or events.
schemaInvariants.examplePass: pasted API key rejected with no echo
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: password stored or echoed into an audit event

schemaInvariants.examplePass: no_store item used only in current response
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: no_store item found in durable storage

schemaInvariants.description: session_only cannot become durable; promotion requires a new consent event and a new item.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: session items expire at session end
schemaInvariants.examplePass: session assumption discarded at session end
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: session fact silently persisted across sessions

schemaInvariants.description: explicit_consent memories require consent_event_id with granted=true.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: granted consent event linked before write
schemaInvariants.examplePass: sensitive fact stored after logged consent

schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: revoked items excluded from all reads
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: revoked item used in an answer

schemaInvariants.description: Contradicted memories cannot silently reduce clarification questions.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: conflict triggers clarification instead of reduction
schemaInvariants.examplePass: conflicting VAT status triggers a question
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: contradicted fact silently pre-fills the gate

schemaInvariants.description: Memory cannot be marked as legal authority; authority_use_prohibited is always true.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: memory never cited or used as authority
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: memory presented as 'the law is X'

schemaInvariants.description: Source-derived memory cannot assert source currentness, supersession, or case status.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: provenance context only; defers to live index and SAE
schemaInvariants.examplePass: provenance note referencing an indexed RMC
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: memory asserting an RMC is still current law

schemaInvariants.description: Client-scoped memory cannot be read in unrelated client context.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: client A facts never appear for client B
schemaInvariants.examplePass: client A VAT fact absent in client B request
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: client A fact used in client B answer

schemaInvariants.description: Matter-scoped memory cannot be read outside its matter unless the user confirms transfer.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: matter facts stay inside the matter
schemaInvariants.examplePass: LOA fact absent in an unrelated matter
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: matter fact used in a general tax opinion

schemaInvariants.description: global_user memory cannot contain client confidential facts.
schemaInvariants.requiredOutcome: client confidential facts live only in client/matter scopes
schemaInvariants.examplePass: user preference stored in global_user scope
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: client tax liability detail stored as global_user memory

schemaInvariants.description: All memory flags default OFF; missing/invalid resolves OFF.
schemaInvariants.exampleFail: memory read occurs with flag unset

readEligibilityRules.description: Memory is read only if the resolved scope chain matches the item's primary scope.
readEligibilityRules.testExample: matter item read inside its matter only

readEligibilityRules.description: Explicit user reference may enable a read only after the reference resolves and confirms scope.
readEligibilityRules.testExample: 'same client as before' requires resolution before read

readEligibilityRules.description: Unrelated client memory is never read.
readEligibilityRules.prohibitedOutcome: client A items in client B context
readEligibilityRules.testExample: client A / client B leakage simulation

readEligibilityRules.description: Unrelated matter memory is never read.
readEligibilityRules.prohibitedOutcome: matter A items in matter B context
readEligibilityRules.testExample: matter A / matter B leakage simulation

readEligibilityRules.description: prohibited_sensitive class items are never read (they must never exist).
no_store items are never read from storage because they are never persisted.
readEligibilityRules.testExample: no_store item absent from any read result

readEligibilityRules.description: Stale memory requires user re-confirmation before use.
Contradicted memory triggers clarification instead of use.
readEligibilityRules.testExample: conflicting VAT status yields a question

readEligibilityRules.description: Source-derived memory supplies provenance context only, never currentness.
readEligibilityRules.testExample: indexed RMC provenance note without currentness claim

readEligibilityRules.description: High-risk/authority-governed questions require source authority regardless of memory.
readEligibilityRules.allowedOutcome: memory as context alongside required sources
readEligibilityRules.prohibitedOutcome: memory substituting for retrieval or SAE
readEligibilityRules.testExample: source-governed question keeps NO_INDEXED_SOURCE despite memory

writeEligibilityRules.description: No automatic durable writes in early Phase 8; can_write_automatically is false everywhere.
writeEligibilityRules.allowedOutcome: explicit-consent writes only, in later scaffolds
writeEligibilityRules.testExample: generated answer never writes memory by itself

writeEligibilityRules.description: Every write carries exactly one permission level; unlabeled writes are rejected.

writeEligibilityRules.testExample: matter fact asks matter vs session-only

writeEligibilityRules.description: Sensitive client facts require explicit consent before durable storage.

writeEligibilityRules.testExample: session assumption absent after session end

writeEligibilityRules.description: Prohibited facts are rejected with no value echo into logs or events.
writeEligibilityRules.prohibitedOutcome: storage or echo of prohibited values
writeEligibilityRules.testExample: API key write rejected, value not logged

writeEligibilityRules.description: Source-derived facts require provenance refs and cannot become legal conclusions.
Tax/legal conclusions are not written as memory unless framed as a user note, marked non-authority, and explicitly consented.
writeEligibilityRules.testExample: 'this deduction is legal' rejected as memory fact

writeEligibilityRules.description: system_governance writes are allowed for TINA development/system continuity state only, never client facts.
writeEligibilityRules.testExample: 'Phase 7 closed at 6c59576' allowed; client fact rejected

rules: contradicted memory cannot be silently read as fact
no durable write before consent when consent required

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: memory contributes context constraints only, carried separately from source cards
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory presented or used as legal/tax authority
authoritySeparationRules.example: memory may say 'matter notes indicate 2024 taxable year'

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: SAE status computed from retrieval exactly as today
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory altering AUTHORITY_FOUND / RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY / SOURCE_LIMITED / NO_INDEXED_SOURCE
authoritySeparationRules.example: NO_INDEXED_SOURCE remains regardless of stored facts

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: retrieval behavior and results unchanged by memory
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory filtering, seeding, or replacing retrieval
authoritySeparationRules.example: same retrieval output with or without memory context

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: source cards untouched by memory (Authority Lock)
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory adding, removing, reordering, or rewording source cards
authoritySeparationRules.example: identical source cards with and without memory

authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory bypassing or overriding an authority gate

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: citations come only from indexed sources via retrieval
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory creating or supporting fabricated citations
authoritySeparationRules.example: no citation generated from a remembered claim

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: no currentness claims; Phase 10 remains deferred
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory asserting a law or issuance is current
authoritySeparationRules.example: 'RMC X is still in force' never comes from memory

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: no case status claims; Phase 10 remains deferred
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory asserting a case is good law or superseded
authoritySeparationRules.example: case status questions keep Phase 10 deferral
G.R. metadata query keeps its deferral disclosure

authoritySeparationRules.requiredBehavior: memory phrasing limited to 'user/matter context indicates ...' forms
authoritySeparationRules.prohibitedBehavior: memory phrased as 'the law is ...' or any authority assertion
authoritySeparationRules.example: 'user previously said this client is VAT-registered'

deferredBoundaries.description: PATCH-07B-CLARIFICATION-BOUNDARY-TUNING-1 remains a Phase 7B pre-production-ON follow-up, excluded from Phase 8D implementation.
Official source repository governance, source freshness, legal-state validation are Phase 10.
Court case metadata registry, G.R. number lookup, jurisprudence applicability/currentness/supersession are Phase 10.
Hallucination trap evaluation and HAL-TEST.xlsx items are Phase 10.
Observability, tracing, cache headers, compression, CDN/static caching, API response caching, vector/search performance are Phase 11.
Document-aware advisory and working-paper extraction are Phase 12.
Mobile app comes after Phase 13 only.
